title: Declarative chart and diagram SVG
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for compiling structured data tables and component message traces into publication-grade accessible SVGs (confidence-interval forest plots, progression bars, and edge-packet diagrams) with deterministic WCAG contrast and label-collision checks.
boundaries: Every emitted SVG is pure static XML with role='img', <title>, and <desc>; <script>, <foreignObject>, and event attributes are forbidden.
Progression bars anchor at zero; signed comparisons use confidence-interval forest plots with an explicit null reference.
Figures failing WCAG contrast or label-collision checks exit non-zero and are never marked ready.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for compiling accessible, collision-free SVG charts and message diagrams

value.lets_workers: Turn validated numeric tables and component message sequences into accessible SVG forest plots, progression bars, and edge-packet diagrams verified for WCAG contrast and zero label collisions.
value.not_for: Interactive browser dashboards, executing embedded scripts, or fabricating unmeasured error bars.

flow.when: Map source numbers or trace steps into a typed figure spec.
Render deterministic SVG markup with diagram_svg.
Verify XML safety, WCAG contrast, and label bounding boxes.
Widen spacing or darken palette slots if any check fails.

nouns.title: Method: declarative data spec to audited static SVG

lifecycle: specify-declarative-figure validates chart_kind, units, intervals, or message endpoints.
compile-accessible-svg produces deterministic SVG XML and conservative text bounding boxes.
audit-svg-contrast-and-collisions enforces XML well-formedness, script ban, WCAG 4.5/3.0 contrast, and zero label overlap.
revise-colliding-or-faint-layout adjusts spacing or palette colors when audited checks fail.

nouns.title: Guardrail: every SVG carries role='img', title, desc, and zero executable markup

value.rule: Generated SVGs must parse cleanly via ElementTree, expose non-empty <title> and <desc> referenced by aria-labelledby, and contain zero <script>, <foreignObject>, <iframe>, or on* event attributes.
value.how_it_is_checked: audit_svg_document walks every XML element and attribute deterministically.

nouns.title: Guardrail: text meets 4.5:1 contrast, marks meet 3.0:1, and labels never collide

value.rule: Foreground text and muted annotations require >= 4.5:1 contrast against background, graphical marks require >= 3.0:1, and pairwise estimated text bounding boxes must have zero overlap.
value.how_it_is_checked: diagram_svg computes linearized sRGB luminance ratios and O(N^2) padded rectangle intersections.

nouns.title: Deterministic layout geometry, sRGB contrast formula, and text bbox estimation
Template: declarative SVG chart or edge-packet specification

value.describes: a declarative JSON specification for forest_plot, progression_bars, or edge_packet_diagram

nouns.title: Template: deterministic SVG accessibility, contrast, and collision audit

value.describes: audit receipt verifying XML safety, WCAG contrast ratios, and zero label collisions

nouns.title: Template: compiled accessible SVG document and audit digest

value.describes: an audited SVG document paired with its SHA-256 digest and passed check summary

nouns.title: WCAG 2.1 contrast check fixture for default and faint palettes

value.purpose: Verify the default SVG palette's text, muted text, and graphical marks against #FFFFFF.

nouns.title: Tool card: diagram_svg standard-library SVG compiler and auditor

value.name: diagram_svg
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Renders forest_plot, progression_bars, and edge_packet_diagram specs to accessible SVG.
Audits XML safety, WCAG 2.1 sRGB contrast ratios, and pairwise text label collisions.
does_not: Fetch external web fonts, execute scripts, or open network connections.

nouns.title: W3C Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) 2 Candidate Recommendation

value.provides: SVG element structure, viewBox geometry, markers, and accessible title/desc semantics.

nouns.title: W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Contrast (Minimum & Non-text)

value.provides: Relative luminance formula and 4.5:1 text / 3.0:1 graphical object contrast thresholds.

nouns.title: Worked example: made-up 3-node lease and CAS write packet diagram spec

instance.title: Worker Lease and CAS Store Sequence
instance.description: Four-step packet trace across Worker, Queue, and CAS Store.

value.shows: A declarative sequence diagram spec that compiles with zero collisions and 17.74:1 text contrast.

verbs.title: Draft a declarative SVG chart or edge-packet specification from pinned data
verbs.summary: Map a pinned table or component trace into a schema-valid forest_plot, progression_bars, or edge_packet_diagram JSON specification.
verbs.outcome: A declarative figure specification ready for deterministic compilation.

slots.name: source_data
slots.description: Pin of the measured data or trace to visualize.

steps: Verify the source_data pin and copy numbers or message steps without inventing unmeasured intervals.
Choose forest_plot for signed intervals, progression_bars for non-negative totals, or edge_packet_diagram for component flows.

acceptance.check: Every plotted number or step comes from source_data.

verbs.title: Compile a declarative specification into an accessible SVG bundle
verbs.summary: Run diagram_svg render --audit-json on a declarative figure specification to produce static accessible SVG markup and its SHA-256 digest.
verbs.outcome: A compiled SVG bundle that passed audit_svg_document.

slots.name: figure_spec
slots.description: Pin of the declarative figure specification.

network: Runs local standard-library diagram_svg compiler only.
steps: Run python3 -m diagram_svg render --audit-json on the pinned figure_spec.
Confirm audit.passed is true and record svg_sha256 plus svg_markup.

verbs.title: Audit an SVG figure for XML safety, WCAG contrast, and label collisions
verbs.summary: Run audit_svg_document to verify ElementTree XML validity, role='img' accessibility, zero scripts, WCAG 4.5/3.0 contrast, and zero colliding text boxes.

slots.name: svg_bundle
slots.description: Pin of the compiled SVG bundle.

steps: Parse svg_markup with ElementTree and run diagram_svg's safety, contrast, and bbox collision checks.
Record exact label_count, collision_count, and text_contrast_ratio.

acceptance.check: collision_count == 0 and text_contrast_ratio >= 4.5 when passed is true.

verbs.title: Revise figure spacing or palette colors after a contrast or collision failure
verbs.summary: Adjust column_spacing, shorten verbose edge labels, or replace low-contrast hex colors so a failed figure spec passes diagram_svg's audit.
verbs.outcome: A revised declarative figure specification that compiles cleanly.

slots.name: failed_spec
slots.description: Pin of the figure spec that failed audit.

slots.name: svg_audit
slots.description: Pin of the failing SVG audit receipt.

network: Re-runs local diagram_svg audit to confirm the fix.
steps: Inspect svg_audit for colliding label pairs or low-contrast palette slots.
Increase column_spacing or darken foreground colors without altering underlying data values, then re-verify with diagram_svg.
